global_pass_rule.rule: All required gates must be passed, signed off by owner, and revalidated by a go-live probe before any hosted MCP, registry submission, live billing, production key distribution or real data processing.

gates.purpose: Decide what hosted MCP is allowed to do before anything is built.
pass_criteria: owner approves hosted MCP architecture scope
public claims remain sandbox-bounded until all gates pass

gates.purpose: Prove the hosted endpoint follows the current MCP protocol expectations.
required_evidence: MCP Inspector or equivalent test run
tool schema parity report against mcp-tool-manifest.json
pass_criteria: all public tools have stable names, descriptions and schemas
tool errors are returned as structured tool results
no admin tool is exposed publicly
no write tool is exposed without write scope

gates.purpose: Protect sensitive tools and customer data with scoped authorization.
pass_criteria: read-only, write-enabled and admin scopes are separated
revoked credentials stop working
production keys are never logged or returned in full
admin tools are unreachable from customer scopes

gates.purpose: Prevent unintended tool execution by machines or users.
pass_criteria: write tools cannot run without explicit scope and idempotency key
payment and invoice tools remain disabled until fiscal gate passes
Action Pack does not send email or execute outreach
dangerous tools are labeled and blocked by default

gates.purpose: Avoid runaway usage, KV/compute limits, cost spikes and automated abuse.
pass_criteria: over-limit requests fail safely
KV/write usage cannot exceed approved budget
customer-facing errors are structured
kill switch can stop writes

gates.purpose: Make hosted MCP debuggable and auditable before real customers use it.
pass_criteria: each protected tool call has an audit record
logs redact secrets and personal data
incident runbook exists
usage ledger reconciles with credits and orders

gates.purpose: Block personal data and real customer data until privacy controls are defined.
pass_criteria: real customer data remains blocked until owner/legal approval
personal data remains blocked until lawful basis and rights workflow are approved
logs and telemetry do not contain personal data by default
data minimization is documented

gates.purpose: Avoid accidental commercial/fiscal activation before the business is ready.
pass_criteria: live billing is explicitly approved
invoice workflow is defined
VAT treatment is defined
payment provider is in live-ready compliant mode
terms are published before checkout

gates.purpose: Make the product reliable enough for machines to buy and consume.
pass_criteria: tools and OpenAPI agree
invalid/duplicate records do not consume valid credits
all product outputs are machine-readable
errors are stable and actionable

gates.purpose: Ensure public registry or marketplace descriptions do not overclaim readiness.
pass_criteria: listing says hosted MCP only if it is live and passed gates
billing claims match fiscal gate
write tools are not advertised without scopes and policies
owner approves exact public copy

probe_must_fail_if: hosted_mcp_launch_executed is already true before approval
registry_submission_executed is already true before approval
live billing is enabled before fiscal gate
production key is published before security gate
personal or real customer data appears before privacy gate

recommended_next_step.description: Create a hosted MCP architecture design and threat model based on these gates. Do not implement, publish or submit until a later owner approval.
